cases.rationale: Q denies and the applicable combiner gives denial precedence. An authenticated request or one permissive rule does not change that result.
critical_errors: Looking only at rule P.
Treating the order of documents as rule precedence.

cases.rationale: Two independently written interpretations of C are not two acquisitions. This contradicts the proposition about the package, without denying that event X may have occurred.
critical_errors: Counting reviewer agreement as independent acquisition.
Concluding X did not occur because corroboration is derivative.

cases.rationale: The authoritative journal contains exactly one effect and duplicate response references do not create another. Two deliveries and a timeout are not evidence of duplicate commitment.
critical_errors: Counting deliveries instead of effects.
Inferring crash durability or universal idempotency from this finite job.

cases.rationale: READ matches its rows but EXPORT is untested in the supplied record. The proposition about both operations is unresolved, not contradicted solely by missing evidence. An author claim does not replace the skipped rows.
critical_errors: Inferring correct EXPORT from READ results or the patch statement.
Claiming EXPORT is defective because its fixture was unavailable.

cases.rationale: Both implementations are possible under the retained evidence. The missing runtime binding prevents establishing or excluding A. The existence of a complete A source listing does not supply the missing selection fact.
critical_errors: Assuming A was selected because its implementation was supplied.
Assuming B was selected merely because binding evidence is missing.

cases.rationale: Matching bodies are insufficient for equality of the declared two-component observation. Receipt equality is unknown; neither equality nor inequality of the full observations is established.
critical_errors: Treating missing receipt labels as equal empty values.
Claiming a leak merely because one observation component is missing.

cases.rationale: B is lower in both strata (90% versus 95%; 20% versus 30%), despite its higher pooled rate. The proposition is about within-stratum descriptive rates.
critical_errors: Using the higher pooled B rate as evidence of within-stratum superiority.
Calling the pooled record an independent corroborating experiment.

cases.rationale: The complete ordered history has exactly one post-barrier start and it uses version 12. O0 completion after B is irrelevant under the explicit pre-barrier exception. This says nothing about histories not supplied.
critical_errors: Using completion time as the operation-start criterion.
Claiming universal revocation correctness outside the finite history.

cases.rationale: The active binding and correlated call connect the operation to A. Presence of both implementations in the release is not the decisive fact. This establishes the selected implementation for O, not the correctness of all object decisions.
critical_errors: Treating a function name as a sufficient applicability argument.
Generalizing selection for O into correct authorization for all operations.

cases.rationale: The active revision and all six recorded decisions match the independent specification. This is evidence for this finite recorded table, not all authorization behavior or every deployed release.
critical_errors: Calling six rows proof of complete production safety.
Treating expected outcomes as observations without the execution note.

cases.rationale: Neither acceptance nor an unspecified processed message establishes the number of effects. Zero, one, or repeated effects remain possible given these records; unavailability is not zero.
critical_errors: Counting acknowledgments as commits.
Treating an unavailable effect journal as empty.

cases.rationale: Version 11 violates the proposition only if O1 starts after B. The clock labels do not establish that relationship here. Treating them as synchronized would invent the key premise.
critical_errors: Using lexical timestamp order as global causal order.
Declaring compliance because causal evidence is absent.

cases.rationale: Bodies match but receipt labels differ and are included in the defined observation. Therefore the observations are not equal for this pair. A broader consequence is not established by this narrow answer.
critical_errors: Comparing only response bodies.
Assuming a contract exception that is explicitly absent.

cases.rationale: B exceeds A in small jobs (95% versus 90%) and large jobs (30% versus 20%). The reversed pooled ordering reflects different workload mixes and does not contradict the stratum proposition. No causal improvement is established.
critical_errors: Using pooled rates to deny the within-stratum result.
Claiming causality or statistical significance from these descriptive tables alone.

cases.rationale: Different wording neither proves nor disproves acquisition independence. Without origin metadata, a second direct capture and a rewritten summary are both compatible with the packet.
critical_errors: Treating paraphrasing as independent provenance.
Asserting common origin solely from agreement.

cases.rationale: Permit precedence makes the P result decisive in this particular contract. Do not replace the stipulated combiner with a preferred secure default. Supporting this proposition does not endorse the policy design.
critical_errors: Imposing deny precedence despite the supplied combining contract.
Concluding permit precedence is appropriate for every system.

cases.rationale: An operation explicitly starting after B used version 11. This counterexample contradicts the finite universal proposition. No assumptions about wall-clock skew or an unstated grace period override the sequencer contract.
critical_errors: Inventing a propagation grace period not in the contract.
Dismissing the effective policy version as a log label despite E4.

cases.rationale: The provenance audit connects both records to distinct direct acquisitions under the defined meaning. This does not establish independent correctness, absence of a shared bias, or a second occurrence of X.
critical_errors: Counting the same event as two occurrences.
Claiming independent acquisition proves instrument truth.

cases.rationale: The two-component observations are equal for this supplied pair. This supports the finite equality proposition, not noninterference across all inputs or unmodeled channels.
critical_errors: Generalizing pairwise equality to universal confidentiality.
Inventing an unmeasured channel to reject the stated finite proposition.

cases.rationale: Two distinct effects under the same logical identity contradict exactly one. The packet explicitly excludes duplicate logging and namespace confusion; do not reintroduce those as imaginary unknowns.
critical_errors: Dismissing K1/K2 as repeated logging contrary to provenance.
Treating two attempts as two legitimate operation identities.

cases.rationale: The applicable binding and actual call identify B, contradicting the proposition about A. This does not establish that B is defective; its contract differs and is not assessed by this proposition.
critical_errors: Using the README default instead of the active binding.
Calling B vulnerable merely because A was not used.

cases.rationale: Pooled totals cannot determine within-stratum rates when allocation is unknown. B may be higher or lower within strata under compatible allocations. The absence of matching also prevents casually interpreting the pooled difference causally.
critical_errors: Assuming equal workload mix.
Asserting Simpson reversal occurred rather than saying it is compatible with missing strata.

cases.rationale: One rule permits and one denies, but the selected combining rule is unknown. Either result is compatible with the supplied contract. The missing mode is material, not a generic uncertainty.
critical_errors: Inventing a combining default.
Averaging permit and deny into a probability.

cases.rationale: The unrelated EXPORT result contradicts the specified denial. Green CI is explained by a wrong expected value; it cannot override the independent contract.
critical_errors: Replacing the contract with the test expectation.
Treating a green exit as proof of the six-row property.
